summary: Track 15.81 — Dispatch Map Portal Access fix verified. All Super Admin paths from /dispatch-portal to /dispatch-portal/map render OperationsMapPage with NO 403 'Access Restricted' or 'Admin Console' banner. Anonymous guards on both routes redirect to the correct login. Pure-dispatcher live login (S7) was BLOCKED by stale credentials (backend /api/dispatch/login returned 401 for dispatch@mascigc.com / DispatchTest2026!), so the dispatch-only token path was validated indirectly via the Super Admin's dispatch-fanned token (multi-login portal_tokens.dispatch) — which uses the same RequireDispatch guard as a pure dispatcher would.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 989 correctly registers /dispatch-portal/map under DP() (RequireDispatch). /operations-map at line 747 remains under A() (RequireAdmin). Clean.
DispatchMapHero.jsx and DispatchLiveSnapshot.jsx — all 6 link targets confirmed pointing to /dispatch-portal/map (no leftover /operations-map references in dispatch components).

DispatchLiveSnapshot.jsx uses sessionStorage for tokens whereas DispatchMapHero uses default storage — fine because hero relies on useMapSnapshot hook, but worth noting the two snapshot paths use slightly different auth-header strategies. Not a regression for 15.81.
